## Adversarial review
<!-- Answer all five concretely; boilerplate is a review blocker (see REVIEW.md). -->
1. Why needed — what concrete defect or failure does this prevent?
2. What breaks if not — what happens if this PR never merges?
3. Simpler alternative — what did you consider and why not?
4. Cost — what does this add (code, deps, maintenance, CI time)?
5. What would falsify it / when to delete — under what condition should this be removed?
